paragraphs: Tavi reports in the name of Mar Ukva, who reports in the name of Shmuel: [Rosh Hashanah 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.22a.7).[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Tavi son of Mari Tavi, Mar Ukva and Shmuel in that order.
